interpretation.overlay_rule: For operation-matrix rows 12 and 13 only, this reviewed supplement resolves FINALITY_DEPENDENCY_ABI_AND_ADR0020_NOT_FROZEN for Proposed-packet evaluation. The same stop remains effective for row 22.
interpretation.go_meaning: GO permits the current Proposed packet semantics and measurement prototypes to use the frozen dependency transcript. It is not implementation acceptance, packet acceptance, deployment authorization, or a readiness claim.
interpretation.no_go_meaning: NO_GO is a hard implementation stop. No optimistic bit, placeholder ABI, zero stub, or inferred recovery predicate may replace the missing accepted reconciliation.
interpretation.dependency_owner: The registry owns every dependency address, code-identity check, state read, predicate, commitment, and reread. The stateless validation adapter calls neither Core nor the finality registry.
interpretation.failure_rule: Any call failure, noncanonical return, length mismatch, predicate mismatch, stale observation, unexpected code identity, or reread drift fails before a durable write or normative event.

deployment_bindings.rule: Addresses and hashes are deployment inputs, not literal source-build constants in this supplement.
required_for_each_dependency: keccak256 of exact initcode including constructor arguments
deployment manifest and receipt binding those values

finality_registry.constructor_identity_rule: The retained deployment record binds this finality registry to the same Core and artist-registry line used by the operation.

artist_registry_component.live_rule: EXTCODEHASH(address(registry)) equals the deployment-supplied expected runtime code hash

forbidden_substitutions: source artifact runtime hash used without deployment binding
successful call treated as code-identity proof
constructor address inferred from caller-supplied data

strict_call_policy.lock: registry-wide lock acquired before the first dependency observation

finality_collection_record.decode: (bool finalized,bytes32 finalityRecordHash,bytes32 manifestContentHash,bytes32 manifestURIHash,string finalityManifestURI,bytes32 componentsHash,address manifestPointer,uint64 finalizedAt)
canonical_rules: tuple head is exactly eight words
string offset relative to the tuple start equals 0x100
string tail immediately follows the tuple head
no gaps, aliases, overlaps, or trailing bytes

finality_components.decode: (bytes32 componentType,address component,bytes4 interfaceId,bytes32 codeHash,bytes32 moduleVersion,bytes32 manifestHash,bytes32 dataHash)[] components
canonical_rules: each element is exactly seven static ABI words
bytes4 is left-aligned and its lower 224 bits are zero
no element offsets, gaps, aliases, overlaps, or trailing bytes

current_state_digest.narrow_value_rule: Every address, bytes4, bool, uint8, and uint64 fact is canonically ABI-extended.

row_12.authority_state_hash_recipe: keccak256(abi.encode(artistId, signer, authorityClass, operativeAuthorityRecordHash, authorityRevision, delegationRecordHash, delegationUseCount, delegationMaxUses))
row_12.sanction_grant_lineage_hash_recipe: keccak256(abi.encode(grantSourceClass, grantRecordHash, grantingArtistId, grantedSteward, grantedCapabilityMask, provisional, superseded, revoked, terminalGovernanceActionId))
row_12.component_fact_recipe: abi.encode(COMPONENT_ARTIST_SANCTION, address(registry), bytes4(0x1300f2d7), expectedArtistRegistryRuntimeCodeHash, artistRegistryModuleVersion, artistRegistryModuleManifestHash, candidateSanctionRecordHash)

all_authorities: binding and generation are the exact live binding for artistId and collectionId
attribution state permits a sanction and is neither DISPUTED nor REVOKED
signer authority and collaborator policy are current
scopeType is a known value and tokenId/scopeId have the source-pinned canonical shape
bound Core, finality registry, and artist-registry component code identities equal deployment bindings
candidate component codeHash equals the deployment-supplied artist-registry runtime code hash
steward_additional: signer is the currently vested steward
CAP_SANCTION comes from an operative nonprovisional nonsuperseded nonrevoked artist-signed grant or a separately executed TERMINAL_FREEZE governance grant

predicates: caller supplies no authority; the transition is permissionless truth confirmation
binding and generation are the exact live collection binding
stored sanction is verified, undisputed, unrevoked, collection scope, and exact for collectionId, artistId, and bindingGeneration
record.finalityRecordHash equals the supplied nonzero finalityRecordHash
componentCount equals components.length and is between 1 and 32
components contain exactly one COMPONENT_ARTIST_SANCTION entry
the sanction entry component equals address(registry)
the sanction entry codeHash equals the deployment-supplied artist-registry runtime code hash
the sanction entry moduleVersion and manifestHash equal the deployment-bound artist-registry component facts
the sanction entry dataHash equals sanctionRecordHash
all entries are in the finality registry's canonical sorted-unique order

phase_order: check dependency addresses and live code hashes
perform the first complete dependency observation pass
compute currentStateDigest from the first pass
call and accept the stateless validation adapter
repeat every applicable code check and dependency call with identical calldata
require exact decoded-value and raw-returndata equality with the first pass
recheck host-local binding, authority, grant, sanction, and transition facts
reread_policy.row_12_steward: Reread Core code hash and collectionBurnsBlockedAtBlock with identical calldata. The accepted Core burn latch is one-way, but that property does not waive the exact reread.
reread_policy.row_12_non_steward: Recheck Core/finality/artist-registry deployment code identities and every host-local fact; no Core or finality function call is introduced.
reread_policy.row_13: Reread collectionFinalityRecord, finalityComponentCount, finalityComponents, and verifyFinality with identical calldata, plus all dependency code identities. Every raw return and decoded fact must match the first pass, and verify.currentRouteMatches must remain true.
one_way_latches: Core collection burn activation is zero until set and then immutable
an executed collection finality record and its stored component array are immutable on the current finality line
reread_policy.drift_result: revert with no durable write, replay consumption, record, state transition, or normative event
